decks.notes: This deck focuses on fast and efficient creature aggression combined with disruption and card advantage. The goal is to control the game tempo by playing threats like Bilbo, Thief in the Night and Nethergoyf, while using cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect them. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Mishra's Bauble help to draw cards and provide additional advantage. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the deck uses the manabase efficiently with Wasteland and fetch lands for consistency.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on using creatures with aggressive abilities and strong combat stats to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also incorporates a few non-creature spells like Goblin Bombardment and Swords to Plowshares for additional removal and damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides an additional mana source and adds flexibility to the deck. By efficiently utilizing its resources and leveraging its creatures' abilities, this deck aims to quickly establish board control and deal significant damage to the opponent.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly through Cloudpost/Tron lands to cast powerful spells like Ugin, Eye of the Storm, Eldrazi Confluence, and Karn, the Great Creator. It also includes disruptive elements such as Force of Negation and Force of Will to control the game. The goal is to overpower the opponent with efficient spellcasting and use powerful threats like The One Ring and Thundertrap Trainer to close out the game. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent through its ramp and control elements.

The main concept of this Doomsday Combo deck is to use Doomsday to stack your library in a way that allows you to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. By combining powerful spells like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal with control elements like Force of Will and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to set up a winning combo as quickly and efficiently as possible. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering, while Murktide Regent offers a threatening backup win condition. The deck seeks to win the game before the opponent has a chance to establish their own game plan.

This Bant Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counter spells and removal, while also utilizing card draw and tutors to maintain card advantage and find key pieces. The deck includes threats that can quickly close out the game, such as Murktide Regent and Quantum Riddler. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card selection and flexibility. The mana base is designed to provide access to all necessary colors, with fetch lands and dual lands. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while assembling a winning board state.

The deck is centered around quickly getting out a big threat, such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, using Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat it onto the battlefield. This combo is supported by counter magic like Force of Will and versatile cards like Cunning Wish. The deck aims to ramp up quickly with Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, while also having access to additional cards and protection through cards like Brainstorm and Veil of Summer. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful threat before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, then using cards like Reanimate and Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. Cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal help accelerate your mana to get your combo pieces out quickly, while cards like Cabal Therapy and Unmask help disrupt your opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate your creatures while disrupting your opponent's plays, leading to a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack to put powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will, Brainstorm, and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect your combo. With access to mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and win the game before they can react effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a lock on the game by using powerful artifacts to control the board and restrict the opponent's options. By utilizing cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms, Trinisphere, The One Ring, and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and prevent them from mounting a successful offense. Additionally, cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Manifold Key can be used to further manipulate the board state and lock down the game in favor of the player piloting this control-artifacts prison deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing the mana acceleration from the Elves creatures to quickly ramp into powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth or Atraxa, Grand Unifier using Natural Order or Green Sun's Zenith. The deck also includes various protection and utility creatures like Allosaurus Shepherd and Wirewood Symbiote to ensure the combo pieces can stick on the board. The mana base is optimized to support the high number of green spells and Gaea's Cradle is a key land for generating massive amounts of mana to fuel the combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to mill your entire library and put Narcomoeba into play. This allows you to use Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle and win the game immediately. The deck also includes protection with Force of Will and removal with Swords to Plowshares, while utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card advantage and selection. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps tutor for key pieces of the combo, making the deck consistent and powerful in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures and then use reanimation spells like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave to bring them back into play. This combo-based strategy allows you to cheat expensive or game-winning creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly and overwhelm your opponent. Cards like Faithless Looting and Cabal Therapy help you put creatures into the graveyard efficiently, while cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal allow you to cast your spells ahead of schedule.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing creatures like Amped Raptor and Sand Scout to deal damage quickly. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent and maintain board advantage to secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to lock down the opponent's resources and limit their options through a combination of artifacts and control elements. By utilizing cards like Ugin and Karn, as well as cards like Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void, the goal is to prevent the opponent from casting spells effectively. The inclusion of cards like Grim Monolith and Disruptor Flute also allow for additional control over the game state. The deck aims to establish a board presence that is difficult for the opponent to overcome, leading to a gradual advantage and eventual victory.

This Dragon Stompy deck aims to disrupt opponents' mana bases while quickly deploying powerful threats like Broadside Bombardiers and Magus of the Moon. With cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere, it can shut down opposing strategies and control the pace of the game. Fury and Sundering Eruption provide removal options, while cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox accelerate the deck's game plan. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Screaming Nemesis add additional threats and versatility to the deck, making it a potent aggro option in the Legacy format.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and Borborygmos Enraged using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Cabal Therapy, then bring them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Goryo's Vengeance. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Unmask and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand. Additionally, the deck features strong synergies with cards like Animate Dead and Lotus Petal to create explosive plays and win the game through big creatures and devastating combos.
